WITH yearly AS (
  SELECT year(service_date) AS yr, SUM(trips) AS trips
  FROM trips_daily
  WHERE year(service_date) IN (2024, 2025)
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  MAX(CASE WHEN yr = 2024 THEN trips END) AS trips_2024,
  MAX(CASE WHEN yr = 2025 THEN trips END) AS trips_2025,
  ROUND(100.0 * (MAX(CASE WHEN yr = 2025 THEN trips END) - MAX(CASE WHEN yr = 2024 THEN trips END))
        / MAX(CASE WHEN yr = 2024 THEN trips END), 1) AS pct_change
FROM yearly
notes: Assumes trips_daily covers all provider types and boroughs for full calendar years 2024 and 2025, and percent change is (2025 − 2024) / 2024.

WITH c AS (
  SELECT SUM(complaints) AS complaints
  FROM complaints_daily
  WHERE year(opened_date) = 2024
),
t AS (
  SELECT SUM(trips) AS trips
  FROM trips_daily
  WHERE year(service_date) = 2024
)
SELECT
  c.complaints,
  t.trips,
  ROUND(1000.0 * c.complaints / t.trips, 1) AS complaint_rate_per_1000
FROM c, t;
notes: Complaints are counted by opened_date and trips by service_date, both aggregated to 2024 separately before dividing, with all provider types and categories included.
